spotbugs-accepted-findings.review-trigger: Review when command logging, exit-code mapping, or Picocli exception propagation changes.
Review when a dereferenced path no longer comes directly from Files.list of a verified directory.
Review when startup recovery stops being fail-closed or failure propagation and intake shutdown ordering changes.
Review when construction stops copying payload collections or an exposed snapshot becomes mutable.
Review when ArtifactFilter gains singleton identity semantics or configured construction stops using its public constructor.
Review when identifier or type allowlists, quoting, or generated DDL inputs accept new grammar.
Review when repository queries bypass immutable schema resolution, identifier quoting, or value binding.
Review when tuning presets cease to be closed adapter-owned values or a PRAGMA token becomes operator supplied.
Review when migration SQL becomes external or runtime supplied, or user_version stops being a validated positive integer.
Review when export artifacts or columns bypass schema membership, identifier validation, quoting, or bound values.
Review when cleanup becomes asynchronous or resource ownership, accounting, or primary-failure propagation changes.
Review when event listeners or their keyed executor adopt retry, swallow, or exception translation semantics.
Review when recovery diagnostic taxonomy, wrapping, or already-diagnosed failure propagation changes.
Review when run-scope cleanup, observer delivery, suppression summaries, or primary-failure precedence changes.
Review when Java object serialization or a remote DiagnosticException transport boundary is introduced.
Review when lifecycle-managed datasource or transport ownership crosses bootstrap or becomes value semantics.
Review when null-preserving defensive copies, unmodifiable accessors, or collect-all binding validation semantics change.
Review when ingestion cleanup, failed-state accounting, or exact typed primary-failure propagation changes.
Review when admission or release accounting mutates users outside same-key ConcurrentHashMap.compute.
Review when lifecycle admission, reconciliation, projection convergence, or bootstrap observation stops preserving fail-closed failure propagation.
